convert_model: convert a HiggsAudioV2Tokenizer model checkpoint from BosonAI to HuggingFace format
create_feature_extractor: create a DacFeatureExtractor configured for 24kHz audio with hop length 960 and right padding
run_convert_cli: run the conversion CLI to save or push a HiggsAudioV2Tokenizer model to HuggingFace Hub
compute_weight_from_weight_norm: compute plain weights from weight normalization parameters weight_v and weight_g
convert_key: convert original model checkpoint keys to HuggingFace-compatible key names using regex mappings
